geometry_source: data/wings.csv; highest valid score per task across all 6,629 records in data/evaluations.csv and all eight methods
geometry_selection: Maximum recorded geometric-mean L/D among complete valid scores for each task, including online queries and private grades; not restricted to final recommendations. Default: nominal load.
geometry_renderer: analysis/render_wing.py, build_wing; visualization surface resolution reduced for the web
display_note: Wing surfaces only, not CFD volume meshes or pressure fields. Results are recorded data, not live CFD.
